inputs.text: Edit the dragon girl supervisor in image 1. Change ONLY her hairstyle: gather ALL the long loose hair into ONE HIGH PONYTAIL tied high at the back of the head, the ponytail falls behind one shoulder as a single thick wavy silver-white bundle. The sides of her head are tidy and pulled back, her shoulders and suit silhouette are clearly exposed. Keep the front bangs. Remove the large bow on top of her head completely. Bare crown of head between the two dragon horns, NO hair accessories, NO bow, NO ribbons, NO hair clips, NO headband, no ornament. The hair tie is hidden at the back. Preserve the SAME cute face, violet eyes, two lavender dragon horns, chibi body proportions, black blazer with gray highlights and two buttons, white shirt, pale lavender necktie, black pleated skirt, charcoal black round shoes, clipboard held at her side, lavender curled dragon tail on the right, and the front facing neutral standing pose. Same low resolution pixel game sprite style, large square pixel clusters, consistent dark violet outlines, limited flat colors, simple two tone shadows, no detailed strands or gradients. One full body character, centered, plain light gray background, no text.
